description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5360000769594 SPRING,HELICAL,COMP: Line 0001 Qty 100 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0145 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 15. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 07682 1397L014; 07682 139L014; 50601 1397L014; 6K4C8 1397L014. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
